name: Tidewater Teak Lounge Chair
description: A low, wide lounge chair in grade-A teak with a slatted back and a sand-colored cushion in UV-stable, quick-drying fabric. The frame is left unfinished so it silvers to a soft driftwood grey over a season or two, and the loose rope detail on the arms keeps it breezy. It is the chair you sit in with coffee while the balcony is still in shade.
details: 72 cm W x 84 cm D x 78 cm H; seat height 38 cm
Solid plantation teak, naturally oil-rich and rot resistant; weathers to silver-grey or keep golden with annual teak oil
Cushion in solution-dyed acrylic, fade and mildew resistant; cover zips off for washing
Marine-grade stainless steel fixings
Weight capacity 140 kg
Made in Indonesia

name: Dune Bistro Set
description: A round table and two stacking chairs in olive powder-coated aluminum with tapered legs and gently curved seat shells. The set is light enough to carry through a door and sized to fit a narrow balcony, with a slatted table top that sheds rain. It has a low-slung, 1960s café look that works with a plant or two and not much else.
details: Table 60 cm diameter x 72 cm H; chairs 52 cm W x 55 cm D x 78 cm H
Powder-coated aluminum, rust-proof and UV stable; wipe clean
Chairs stack up to four high
Adjustable glides for uneven decking
Chair weight capacity 120 kg each
Made in Vietnam

name: Nook Rope Lounge Chair
description: A cocooning armchair hand-wrapped in terracotta all-weather rope over a matte black aluminum frame, with a woven jute-look cushion. The open weave lets air and light through and gives it a relaxed, collected-on-your-travels feel. It is wide enough to tuck your feet up in and light enough to move with the sun.
details: 76 cm W x 78 cm D x 72 cm H; seat height 36 cm
Powder-coated aluminum frame, rust-proof
Polyolefin rope, UV stable and colorfast; hose down to clean
Cushion in UV-stable olefin fabric with quick-dry foam
Weight capacity 125 kg
Made in Indonesia

name: Pier Teak Bench
description: A plain, beautifully joined teak bench with square legs and a slatted seat, no arms, no back, nothing extra. The pale honey wood and the clean proportions suit a spare balcony where a bench doubles as a plant stand or a low table. Leave it out year-round; teak looks after itself.
details: 120 cm W x 38 cm D x 45 cm H
Solid plantation teak with mortise-and-tenon joints; left unfinished
Naturally weather resistant; weathers to silver-grey outdoors
Stainless steel hardware
Weight capacity 200 kg
Made in Indonesia

name: Cove Fiberstone Planter
description: A tall, tapered planter cast in fiberstone with a mottled, stone-grey surface that looks like weathered concrete at a fraction of the weight. The matte finish and quiet silhouette sit well behind an olive or a grass and leave the plant to do the talking. It is frost-proof and UV stable, so it can stay on a balcony through winter.
details: 35 cm diameter x 50 cm H; 6 kg
Fiberstone (fiberglass-reinforced stone composite), frost and UV resistant
Pre-drilled drainage hole with removable plug
Fits a 30 cm nursery pot
Made in Vietnam

name: Rialto Fluted Planter
description: A deep green glazed planter with vertical fluting and a brushed brass rim, shaped like a scaled-up cocktail glass. The high-gloss glaze catches afternoon light, and the geometric ribs make even a plain fern look dressed up. It is the planter for a balcony that leans toward polished rather than rustic.
details: 32 cm diameter x 32 cm H; 5 kg
Frost-resistant glazed stoneware with powder-coated aluminum rim
Drainage hole and matching saucer included
Glaze is UV stable; wipe clean
Made in Portugal

name: Mesa Terracotta Pots (Set of 3)
description: Three hand-thrown terracotta pots in graduated sizes, each with a slightly flared rim and a raw, chalky surface that blooms with white mineral marks as the plant drinks. They look like a potting shed in the south of Spain, and they are fired hot enough to shrug off frost. Fill them with herbs and line them along a railing.
details: Large 22 cm, medium 17 cm, small 13 cm diameter; heights to match
High-fired terracotta, frost resistant to -10 °C
Drainage holes; saucers sold separately
Each pot varies in color and thickness
Made in Spain

name: Beacon Steel Lantern
description: A square lantern in blackened powder-coated steel with riveted corners, a hinged door and tempered glass panels. It holds a chunky pillar candle or a battery LED and throws a moody, caged light across a railing or a table. The raw, utilitarian build means it can sit out in rain without fuss.
details: 18 cm W x 18 cm D x 36 cm H; 2.4 kg
Powder-coated steel, rust resistant; tempered glass panels
Fits pillar candles up to 10 cm diameter; candle not included
Carry handle on top; hang from a hook or set on a table
Wipe dry after heavy rain
Made in India

name: Shoal Rope Lantern
description: A whitewashed wood lantern with a thick rope handle and clear glass sides, sized for a tealight cluster or a small LED pillar. The pale, slightly chalky finish and the nautical rope give it the light, airy feel of a beach-house porch. Hang it from a hook or set a few along a balcony wall for a soft evening glow.
details: 15 cm W x 15 cm D x 30 cm H
Acacia wood with a UV-stable whitewash sealant; tempered glass
Jute-look polyester rope handle, weatherproof
Fits tealights or pillars up to 8 cm diameter; candle not included
Bring inside in prolonged heavy rain
Made in Vietnam

name: Solis Smoked Glass Solar Lantern
description: A globe lantern in smoked amber glass on a burnt-orange powder-coated aluminum base with a solar panel hidden in the lid. It charges through the day and glows a warm, low amber at dusk, like a 1970s hotel bar lamp that wandered outside. The chunky, rounded shape looks as good unlit on a table as it does glowing on a railing.
details: 22 cm diameter x 28 cm H
Smoked tempered glass globe, UV stable; powder-coated aluminum base and lid
Integrated solar panel and 2700 K LED; up to 8 hours light on a full charge
IP44 weather rating; auto on at dusk
No candle needed; replaceable rechargeable battery
Made in China
